subject: a dark-fantasy ARPG character concept portrait, three-quarter view, painterly game key-art
bestPrompt: Dark-fantasy ARPG hero character concept portrait: a striking sorceress-warlord, tight three-quarter bust, head-and-shoulders, face lit by a warm directional key from upper left with a bright COOL cyan rim-light tracing the far cheek, jaw and shoulder to cut a crisp silhouette off the background. A distinctive hero identity — an ornate blackened-iron horned circlet across the brow, one glowing ember eye, ash-white braided hair, a raven-feather mantle. Painterly AAA key-art in the exact hand-painted style of Diablo IV and Path of Exile 2 class-select splash art and Hades II portraits — confident visible oil brushwork, thick impasto, rich continuous value, art-directed HARD edges and clean shape design, NOT a flat vector emoji, NOT a smooth sticker, NOT a cel-shaded outline, NOT a glossy 3D render, NOT a soft-focus blob. Physically grounded materials: skin with warm subsurface scatter, pores and fine scars; polished dark steel circlet with SHARP bright specular hits and crisp engraved gold trim; structured leather straps; deep sculptural cloth folds in the feather mantle with real form, no AI fuzz. Cinematic chiaroscuro — warm key vs deep cool shadow, strong rim separation, faint haze. Muted desaturated palette, bronze ash and ember-orange accents. Dramatic, high detail, textured brushwork, masterful concept study. Dark graphite background. No text, no watermark, no border, no frame, no logo, no plastic skin, no clean vector shapes, no soft frayed edges.
technique: The dominant lever (38->73) is a full SUBJECT + LIGHTING reframe: name a single, DISTINCTIVE dark-fantasy hero as a tight three-quarter head-and-shoulders BUST (kills the baseline's generic sci-fi badge/symmetry trope), anchor the render to named painterly key-art (Diablo IV / Path of Exile 2 splash art / Hades II) with 'visible oil brushwork / thick impasto / continuous value', and stack anti-vector + anti-photoreal negatives (NOT a flat vector emoji / smooth sticker / cel-shaded outline / glossy 3D render / soft-focus blob) to fight Lucid Origin's flat default. The second lever is an explicit two-light chiaroscuro recipe — a warm directional KEY plus a bright COOL RIM tracing cheek/jaw/shoulder — which drives value-hierarchy and silhouette separation from a dark graphite background (the single biggest recurring docker is the figure's dark lower mass and feather/fur merging into black). Third: itemize the exact weak zones the judge names (subsurface skin, SHARP metal speculars, structured cloth folds, no AI fuzz) so materials read crafted. CRITICAL Lucid-Origin hazard: ornate/engraved props reliably summon garbled runic text or a painted signature (two hard cleanliness caps to 52), so always ban 'runes, lettering, inscriptions, signature, text, watermark' in the negative tail.

iterations.note: Painterly D4/PoE2 bust reframe + warm-key/cool-rim + subsurface-skin/tarnished-metal materials + anti-vector negatives. Jumped 38->63; docked as a generic bald-soldier blob with no rim separation and mushy edges.

WINNER. Added a DISTINCTIVE identity (horned circlet, ember eye, feather mantle) + explicit COOL cyan rim tracing the silhouette. Style cohesion 82, cleanliness 95. Docked for lower torso collapsing to black mush and an unmotivated teal underglow.

Removed engraved circlet -> smooth bone-iron helm with NO writing, banned runes/lettering/inscriptions. Text artifact eliminated (cleanliness 90), but dark feather mantle again merged to near-black and metal read flat grey.

Lighter smoky halo behind shoulders + armor-dominant (less feather) + forged-metal micro-detail push. Best value hierarchy (76), clean (92), but horn banding + soft engraving mush kept it at competent-placeholder, below i2's 73.
